item.text:
<linkedin_post>DoorDash CEO Tony Xu sees room to learn from AI agents while keeping their current use in perspective. On the company’s earnings call, he said DoorDash had received “several hundred” orders in total from third-party agents and that customers still predominantly order through its app.

The company is investing in its own ordering options, including a chatbot that accepts prompts and photos, a text-to-order agent and a command-line tool. It has also made corporate ordering available through other chatbots.

Xu mentioned a possible advertising opportunity inside third-party agents. For DoorDash, that would mean reaching customers in a place where the agent may help choose what they see and order.</linkedin_post>
